E48 finds that adding w_refs=0.028 resolves all 6 cases: refs(eee30)=4 > refs(1f936)=2 provides a 0.006 margin that reverses the 1f936-first ordering. Goldset preference eee30>1f936 is CONSISTENT across all 6 co-appearance cases (6:0). Score lifts from 0.9600 to 1.0000 (Top3Match=1.0, OrderScore=1.0, Stability=1.0). Attack surfaces: (1) margin 332>cecf=0.0085 is thin; (2) margin eee30>1f936=0.006 is thin; (3) any new rejected packet with refs>=5 could shift the cecf side of the cliff. Two operational-state classes exist: (1) .si-state.live → --grn (L67), applied to source surfaces temple.html/focus.html (L247-248) meaning 'currently serving'; (2) .si-state.active → --pur (L71), applied to skills/memories meaning 'currently in use'. Both are runtime observations (not admission events), yet they use different colors. Per E73 boundary: --grn = admission event occurred (operator-authorized ledger write). Temple.html/focus.html being 'live' means they are currently running HTML surfaces — a runtime health signal, not a ledger write. No --teal variable exists in :root (E69 --teal proposal never admitted). Closest existing color for an operational/active state is --pur (already used by .si-state.active for the same semantic). Proposed tweak: .si-state.live → --pur, aligning with .si-state.active and vacating --grn for admission-only use. Contrast: .si-state.shipped → --grn remains correct (claim STARSHIP_V3 was admitted to ledger, per L241).
pairs.b_text: Nodes s2 (temple.html, source/live) and s3 (focus.html, source/live) emit THREE independent --grn signals simultaneously: (1) orbital canvas dot via TYPE_COLOR.source='#00ff88' at L347, (2) stream sidebar si-dot via TYPE_COLOR.source at L459, (3) si-state.live text via .si-state.live{color:var(--grn)} at L67. Three green signals on non-admitted objects = strongest false-admission reading in the graph. E76 (TYPE_COLOR.source) and E74 (.si-state.live) each address one layer; only their joint application eliminates all three. Additional finding: E76's proposed rgba(255,255,255,.65) for TYPE_COLOR.source is partially risky at L387 (pull-ring transform: col.replace(')',',${alpha})') would produce invalid CSS 'rgba(255,255,255,.65,0.08)' for selected source nodes). Hex alternative '#aaaaaa' avoids this — no ')' in hex, transform no-ops safely, pull-rings render at full gray.
